title: ID0424646-DC/Si-D/VN-[ MP / R3 170001682 ] EV connection issue
description:
Reported issue: An EV Vinfast VF7 came to our 160kW DC SiCharge to charge but cannot charge, got problem at 1st step - vehicle integration.
Solution: After the EcoG 1.4.12 update the EV charged succesfully

additional_info.subject: ID0424646-DC/Si-D/VN-[ MP / R3 170001682 ] EV connection issue CRM:02684000253
additional_info.body:
Hello Vu Mai, good evening. I hope you are doing well.
My name is Francisco and I'm the first level of the Vehicle integration team where I do the first troubleshooting of the problem and declare the necessity of a Vehicle integration.
I access the charger remotely and could get the logs from the date you provided and here are my findings, directly from the SECC:
When the vehicle is connected, it waited 1min for a message from the vehicle, which we didn't get. This repeated for the next 2 attempts at charging.
This indicates one of 2 different problems:
Either the plug-in was not done correctly and as such we could not establish the SLAC communication successfully
EV didn't send the request.
Unfortunately, since this charger is in v4.0.11 we do not have access to a more detailed logging from the SECC to provide a more intricate answer.
My recommendation would be to install v6.1.3 or v7.0.5 and I can install a newer version of the SECC which has the improved logging.
If I do not have your permission to install the newer versions, this is all I can provide and it would be required a Vehicle Integration request. If this is the case, then please align with the colleague Seah so that a request is prepared.
Have a nice weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco

But it still got problem as charging at 160kW DC Sicharge.
Pls check and have a solution.
Thanks & Best regards,
Mr. Vu Mai
